fm.title: Instrument io
fm.description: Direct instrument query and command via SCPI/VISA (3 blocks)

rows.intent: Send a command and read the response from a SCPI/GPIB instrument — use for interactive measurement acquisition from test equipment
Send a command string to an instrument without reading a response — use for one-way configuration commands to SCPI/GPIB instruments
Communicate with instruments via the VISA standard — use for vendor-neutral access to GPIB, USB, TCP/IP, or serial instruments

fm.title: Network comm
fm.description: Network-based data exchange over TCP/IP and UDP (4 blocks)

rows.intent: Receive data over a TCP/IP network connection — use for acquiring data from networked instruments, remote systems, or lab equipment
Send data over a TCP/IP network connection — use for transmitting commands or data to networked instruments or remote systems
Receive data over UDP — use for low-latency acquisition from instruments or systems that broadcast measurement data
Send data over UDP — use for low-latency command transmission to instruments or systems that accept UDP messages

fm.title: Serial comm
fm.description: Serial port communication with instruments and devices (3 blocks)

rows.intent: Configure serial port parameters like baud rate and parity — use for setting up RS-232/RS-485 communication before send/receive operations
Receive data from a serial port — use for reading measurement data or responses from serial-connected instruments or microcontrollers
Send data through a serial port — use for transmitting commands or data to serial-connected instruments or microcontrollers
